author: ImRaging
body:
First I wanna give credit to Pizza for coming up with this, but I thought I'd post it since he hasn't :P


So, once a month or so, a post can be made (or bumped every month) asking what our favourite maps are. Then, a certain amount of maps are chosen to go into the rotation (5?) and bam, you have a community that'll keep everyone happy.

A know there are a few problems with this, like 'will the other rots be played?' and 'What if we don't get enough suggestions?'. To be honest, I have no clue. But what would be a suggestion without problems? 

Anyway, I'm pretty sure this'll get lots on -1's because of too many issues but eh, whatever.
